climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in the Limestone Coast zone of South Australia, with about 6,600 acres of vines. Cabernet Sauvignon makes up almost half of plantings, followed by Shiraz at 28%.
